when_used: A chargee transfers a registered charge to a new chargee for a consideration, with the chargor confirming the outstanding amount where the chargor is made a party. The outgoing chargee is passed as the transferor and the incoming one as the transferee, each as a natural person signing by its own duly authorised attorneys, and the chargor signs personally.

detail_rows.label: Charge(s) registered in the Register as Entry Number(s):
Transferor: Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
Transferee: Give full name(s) and company’s registration number, if any
Chargor Give full name(s) and company’s registration number, if any
Consideration for the Transfer (Receipt is hereby acknowledged by the Transferor)
The Principal Amount Secured Under the Charge
Outstanding Amount as confirmed by the Chargor*

body_text.text: The Transferor being the Chargee of the Charge(s) registered as above in the Encumbrances Section of the Register of the above-mentioned Title HEREBY TRANSFERS to the Transferee the interest of the Transferor in the Charge(s).
The Chargor confirms the outstanding amount as set out above*.
Additional Conditions for the Transfer if any:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Transferor and the Transferee (and the Chargor) have signed this Transfer as a deed.

execution.signed_label: SIGNED and SEALED by the duly authorised attorney(s) of the
execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act

signing_recital.transferor: under and by virtue of Powers of Attorney registered at: {{transferor_poa_lands_registry}} Lands registry as number {{transferor_poa_lands_no_1}} and {{transferor_poa_lands_no_2}} and at the registry of Documents at Nairobi as Number {{transferor_poa_docs_no_1}} and {{transferor_poa_docs_no_2}} respectively
signing_recital.transferee: under and by virtue of Powers of Attorney registered at: {{transferee_poa_lands_registry}} Lands registry as number {{transferee_poa_lands_no_1}} and {{transferee_poa_lands_no_2}} and at the registry of Documents at Nairobi as Number {{transferee_poa_docs_no_1}} and {{transferee_poa_docs_no_2}} respectively

foot_notes: *where the Chargor is made a party
**The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.
